_doc: Outfit lane (art round 2): drape patches on the key poses, merged over art/rosace/poses/<pose>.json by tools/pixel-pipeline/outfit_lane.py when it renders the lane's stills (--patch). The pose files themselves are not edited here: Integrate folds a kept patch into the pose file. Each patch names the critique line it answers. Keys: patch name -> {pose: partial pose dict (deep-merged)}.

qtab._why: critique 12 (taste in Q): the splayed-leg crouch put the crotch dead centre with the tabard swung to the side; the tabard now falls between the thighs and covers it (as the keyed lifts do)

hair._why: critique 12 (open back): the hair tail covered the whole back in the back view, so the halter yoke, the back cross and the spine never showed; the tail sweeps to one side. The hair chains are the hair lane's; this is a proposal for the pose owner

hair2._why: as 'hair', the tail swept the other way (over her left shoulder side)

qtab2._why: as 'qtab', with a little of the pose's 'float, then fall' left in the tabard (it trails back and up a touch but still covers the crotch)

tabn2._why: critique 12 (back view): keep the tabard out of the gap between the legs; it swings toward her right, behind the far thigh (a +x swing put it across the near leg)

hair3._why: round 3 (critique 12, back): 'the hair covers the open back, so the halter yoke and back cross never show' - the tail and the back mass swept harder to the far side and lifted, so the spine, the yoke and the 3x5 back cross read; a proposal for the hair lane and the pose owner (O-24)

hair4._why: as hair3, swept over the near shoulder instead (toward the camera side)
